# Decompiler based AI

## Actions

* Build: `make -C src`
* Install: `make user-install`
* Test: `r2 -A -qc "decai -e api=ollamacloud;decai -e model=glm-5;decai -d @ 0x100000924" /bin/ls`

## Hints

* Never read the minified, autogenerated `decai.r2.js`
* Focus and work only on the TypeScript source
* Never run `tsc` or `npx`. Always use `make` targets to compile
